note: Findings with FAIL are demonstrable source-state policy deficiencies, not demonstrated real-world exploit; BLOCKED are unqualified real boundaries

findings.name: RD3_EXCEPTION_MASKED_AS_NO_SEPARATION
findings.threat_scenario: build_packet catches every exception from perfect_separation then substitutes sep=False
findings.precondition: An LP error or patched detector throws while evaluator constructs a packet
findings.potential_impact: NO_PERFECT_SEPARATION may appear true despite an unassessed separation state
findings.evidence_id: RD3 lines 129-132; independent technical review still absent
findings.required_remediation: Prospective fail-closed explicit LP tri-state in isolated qualified boundary, preserving frozen RD3 source
findings.unresolved_question: Can any bypass avoid the RD5 exception-tracing observation?

findings.name: LP_SOLVER_STATUS_REDUCED_TO_SUCCESS_BOOL
findings.threat_scenario: perfect_separation returns bool(sep.success), does not branch on status=unknown/error
findings.precondition: linprog reports timeout/numerical error without raising
findings.potential_impact: False can be incorrectly interpreted as proof of non-separability
findings.required_remediation: Independently qualified tri-state feasibility guard, abort on unknown before fit and after fit
findings.unresolved_question: Which solver status patterns survive wrapper checks under hostile adapters?

findings.name: SYNTHETIC_PROVENANCE_SPOOFABLE
findings.threat_scenario: Equality comparison to fixture.PROVENANCE accepts a caller-controlled string and list
findings.precondition: Caller knows marker and supplies rows previously loaded from prohibited scope
findings.potential_impact: Origin/authenticity of input view and upstream physical read cannot be guaranteed
findings.required_remediation: Future trust-attested separate producer, capability/signed manifest and OS-denied ledger mount; never call synthetic entry directly with real data
findings.unresolved_question: What producer identity and audit attestation could prove physical isolation?

findings.name: TRACE_GUARD_LIMITED_TO_PYTHON_CURRENT_THREAD
findings.threat_scenario: sys.settrace observes Python exception frames with exact candidate.perfect_separation.__code__ identity
findings.precondition: Thread/native subprocess or monkeypatch diverts LP call or switches code object
findings.potential_impact: Guard may not observe transformed or out-of-thread detector failure; no independent proof of bypass execution
findings.evidence_id: RD5 lines 151-168; prior 29/29 synthetic test has one injected exception, not cross-thread/native coverage
findings.required_remediation: Review process boundaries, explicit error/result-code validation, disallow monkeypatching, independent hostile synthetic tests
findings.unresolved_question: Can threat-resilient checks be made independent of runtime tracing?

findings.name: IMPORT_MUTATES_BASE_GLOBAL_SOLVER
findings.threat_scenario: Import-time assignment _base.fit_logistic=fit_logistic changes shared bepd09c_runtime module object
findings.precondition: Imports occur in a shared interpreter with another computation
findings.potential_impact: Other code behavior may depend on mutable import order and global state
findings.evidence_id: R2 overlay line 19, RD3 imports overlay at line 10
findings.required_remediation: Isolate process/module namespace, verify immutable exact code hash, prohibit shared live runtime and global changes
findings.unresolved_question: Does the future isolated worker guarantee a fresh interpreter and pinned import graph?

findings.name: TOP_LEVEL_ONLY_RECEIPT_VALIDATION
findings.threat_scenario: Exact top-level allowlist but optimizer_audit_metadata contains free-form optimizer_message string; nested type/length/content not validated
findings.precondition: Unexpected optimizer strings, tracebacks, paths, or encoded values reach serializer
findings.potential_impact: Potential unwanted diagnostic disclosure; actual sensitive leakage NOT demonstrated
findings.evidence_id: RD5 safe_receipt and optimizer message receipt
findings.required_remediation: Define exact recursive schema, maximum lengths, canonical stop codes, scrub diagnostic strings, test nested adversarial payloads
findings.unresolved_question: Which optimizer metadata values are essential and safe for public receipts?

findings.name: LEGACY_HARNESS_MONOLITHIC_REAL_READ
findings.threat_scenario: read_bytes() loads complete real source and later invokes primary_module.run_protocol
findings.precondition: Legacy harness reused in fold-local training-only path
findings.potential_impact: Physical exposure of current test bytes and execution of test-scoring protocol if run
findings.evidence_id: Harness lines 360-369,398-399; not executed in RD6-02
findings.required_remediation: Block invocation; future separately authorized train-only physical materializer or independently attested already-sharded views
findings.unresolved_question: Can existing sharded data prove origin without any new prohibited read?

findings.name: REFERENCE_SUCCESS_ONLY_SEPARATION_AND_TEST_SCORING
findings.threat_scenario: Reference _fit checks sep.success without unknown status; run_reference contains fold-test metrics and probabilities
findings.precondition: Legacy reference path reused for train-only parity
findings.potential_impact: Unknown LP may proceed and prohibited test scoring could be performed
findings.required_remediation: Future isolated reference _fit wrapper with explicit tri-state, train-only matrices and cross-solver contract; no run_reference
findings.unresolved_question: Which numerical parity threshold will humans select after synthetic qualification?

findings.name: EXACT_RD5_FOLD_WEEK_CHECK_PRESENT
findings.threat_scenario: Fold id and membership of supplied synthetic training row weeks checked; test-week row rejected
findings.precondition: Well-formed synthetic fixture supplies fold-local rows
findings.potential_impact: Proof of bounded synthetic input filtering within supplied rows, not proof of trusted physical origin
findings.required_remediation: Preserve tested synthetic condition while developing separately attested producer interface
findings.unresolved_question: How will equivalent enforcement be guaranteed across independent processes?

findings.name: EXISTING_SYNTHETIC_LP_EXCEPTION_NEGATIVE_TEST
findings.threat_scenario: Injected second internal Candidate B LP exception expected to raise TrainingOnlyBreaker
findings.precondition: Exactly current RD5 synthetic test environment and patched linprog
findings.potential_impact: Evidence of one bounded exception scenario, NOT general threads/native/monkeypatch proof
findings.required_remediation: Keep as frozen regression; add future independent adversarial synthetic tests only after authorization
findings.unresolved_question: Will additional exceptions or different code objects defeat detection?

findings.name: SIGNED_TRAIN_VIEW_MATERIALIZER_ABSENT
findings.threat_scenario: Only a documentary owner/producer/training-view trust-boundary proposal exists
findings.precondition: An unverified real-view object is handed to consumer
findings.potential_impact: No authority-bound provenance or physical read isolation
findings.evidence_id: RD6-01 A design; no materializer or signed attestation
findings.required_remediation: Design/test-first independent producer under separate human authorization; deny real source
findings.unresolved_question: Which trusted owner can create physically admissible fold-scoped data?

findings.name: EXTERNAL_INDEPENDENCE_AND_ATTESTATION_NOT_RECEIVED
findings.threat_scenario: Package requests a signed external independent report but none supplied or commissioned in RD6-02
findings.precondition: Review result represented as externally verified despite no independent reviewer
findings.potential_impact: False readiness/authority escalation, rather than a demonstrated code exploit
findings.evidence_id: RD6-01 reviewer requirement; no external report available
findings.required_remediation: Separate authorized reviewer handoff; authenticate reviewer identity/conflicts/evidence; no automatic PASS
findings.unresolved_question: Who independently reviews and how is provenance verifiable?

findings.name: REAL_REFERENCE_GATE_AND_TOLERANCE_UNADOPTED
findings.threat_scenario: Objective gap candidate 1e-8 and reference stationarity are proposal only
findings.precondition: Threshold silently copied into actual real run
findings.potential_impact: Unpreregistered gate and post-hoc scientific change
findings.evidence_id: RD6-01 C candidate and human closure reject automatic adoption
findings.required_remediation: Separately test and human-adopt exact formula+threshold on synthetic corpus
findings.unresolved_question: Which parity metric/threshold survives preregistered sensitivity?

findings.name: REAL_BUDGET_AND_TIER_A_OPEN
findings.threat_scenario: Real 10+10 fits, CPU/memory/time/cost are candidate not adopted; P0.4/P0.6 fail in external run history
findings.precondition: Operator treats documentary budget or RD5 synthetic GREEN as real authorization
findings.potential_impact: Unauthorized real resource usage and global-regression misrepresentation
findings.required_remediation: Separate human resource/data authority and external regression review
findings.unresolved_question: What real resource and read scope can be authorized safely later?
